# kind: # O.BIN names stay as spelled; add concise English comments at their definitions when the application batch lands.

note: Dispatches mode_stage 0 to the phone-call flow and 1 to the girl-profile flow; other stages reset to title.
Runs mode_step 0..4 for the opening call phases and then draws the phone HUD, parameter display, text, date, cursor and mascot each frame.
Dispatches phone-call submodes by mode_step, including dial, reply, date invitation, profile inquiry, and special call branches; each branch's concrete behavior is named separately below.

Rings, maps current_girl 0xB to target 0xC, then routes on today's matching appointment, the exact date (year 0x62/month 2/day 0x16), the next-28-day slot count, and the target value; these are direct conditions, meanings of the special date and target 0xC are not inferred.

Increments target girl's flags.b[3]; rank 4 sets affection to 0x10, ranks below 2 and rank 2 take different mode-step branches with girl-specific exceptions, and other ranks route to another branch. Ranks are the return from get_g_zyotai_s.
Scans the following 28 calendar days; includes only day_kind 1 or 2 and skips any day where appointment_find_today finds a booked slot; returns count and fills date/menu rows.

Builds two-page place menu and resolves invitation result. Chance value combines max(rank/4,trivia/4), a girl/place table entry and looks adjustment; random byte < chance schedules appointment. Whether chance succeeds or fails, affection changes by frame_count&3 and syoushin decreases by 12, clamped at zero; failure also raises stress by 9 and guts by rand()&7. The source's signed failure delta is always below 0x66, so it always selects substep 0x40; later result comparisons cannot be reached on this branch. Success stores place/date/girl/active fields in AppointmentEntry.

Builds availability for date-place ids 0..20 by page. Unlocked progress entries are enabled subject to month exclusions; locked places require specific packed GameState flags/year/month gates; seasonal weather callback controls sea/pool/skating/ski entries, while shrine has a flag, August, and first-week gate. Packed flag meanings remain unknown.
Reads girl id from appointment slot 0, clears bit 0x20 in active appointment entries for that same girl, then invokes the appointment sorter/updater.

Builds the profile appraisal screen for met girls. Uses rank and points from func_80053418; points >= 500 show zero stars, otherwise rank thresholds <6/<11/<21/<41/<61 give 6/5/4/3/2 stars and all higher ranks give 1. Stores stars+1 in record 15's scene_counters; shows a separate icon for syoushin >= 0x3C.

Draws selected girl's seven phone digits, birthday, year-banded body measurements, zodiac, blood type, club and two note rows; target 0xB reads girl record 12 for profile data and uses a special club label.

# kind: # OPTION — settings menu, optional extras and audio test

note: Main options mode dispatcher: mode_stage cases 0..8 route settings and menu pages, default resets to title; calls shared scrolling/input and brightness-fade presentation.
Dispatches mode_step values 0..3, 10..12, 20..23 and 30..40 to sound-test, menu, extra and exit handlers. Steps 21..23 specifically select/play/stop XA tracks.

Allows selection when system_data.flags[sel] or girl_cleared[sel] is set; requests selected XA audio entry and sends audio command 0x300 when CD audio is ready. Cross sends stop command 0x74 and routes forward by two mode steps to the stop/return handler.

Waits for XA completion/readiness and starts successive XA entries from the selected table row until its count is exhausted; cross stops playback and routes back one mode step. This handler has no circle check.
